integrity: The theorem is proved from the literal neighborhood definition. The balanced complete-bipartite case and scalar minimum results already in the literature are treated as prior-covered special cases, not as new results.
scientific_limitations: Originality is assessed against targeted searches and inspected sources; a poorly indexed result under uncommon equivalent terminology remains possible. Finite verification is exhaustive only through order 9 and does not replace the symbolic proof.
title: Fair domination polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
